[Monotonicity of $\delta $, $\epsilon _0$, and $\alpha $] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0188 ↗ thm:chow-iii-pseudolocality-unit-scale 1. ch21:21.10\group Contradiction setup
